title: Project Anime Glider - A mix of Kirby City Trial Online, MOBA, and RPG
author: Mindless_Software_99
selftext:
I was a fan of the Kirby City Trial game in Kirby Air Ride, which is what inspired me to start making this game. It's a new take on the game mode.

The goal is to combine the overall structure of City Trial with collecting power ups, trying to stop your rivals from getting an advantage, and finding better ships. Where it begins to move away from that is an extra layer of item collection, building, and inventory. 

This is where it is at so far. Still in the very early stages. Hope to get some feedback, what you like and don't like, etc.
